title: The Twin-Court Estoc Canon
summary: A canon of the twin-court estoc, in which a second point follows the first into the same breach.

title: Treatise on the Azure Hawk's Plunge
summary: A treatise on the plunge of the azure hawk, the swift dropping thrust from a high and distant stance.

title: The Two-Track Armor Canon
summary: A canon of two tracks of thrust, one against the plate and one against the flesh beneath it.

title: The Deep Basin Thrust Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of the deep basin, where stillness gathers and the point is driven from its quiet depths.

title: The River Convergence of Points
summary: A large manual in which many currents of thrust meet like tributaries at a single river mouth.

title: The Paired Hawk Estoc Mastery
summary: A mastery text in which two hawks hunt together, one binding the prey while the other strikes.

title: The Twin Spire Estoc Treatise
summary: A rare treatise for a Monarch, raising two spires of qi along the blade to climb through a foe's guard.

title: The Wind-Sworn Estoc Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn estoc, whose point crosses the plateau as swiftly as a passing gust.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Edge Thrust
summary: A treatise on the thrust made at the plateau's edge, driving a foe toward the drop.

title: The Bearing Held Through Plate Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of keeping the bearing unchanged as the point passes through plate and everything beneath.

title: The Gale Oath Point Mastery
summary: A compact mastery text in which an oath sworn to the gale gives the final thrust its force.

title: The Unwalled Plateau Estoc Canon
summary: A large canon for fighting in open country, where nothing stands between the swordsman and the sky.

title: Treatise of the Long Gale Reach
summary: A treatise on extending the estoc's reach by a long gale of qi that runs beyond the tip.

title: The Monarch's Oath Bearing Treatise
summary: A rare treatise for a Monarch, binding an oath to a single unmoving bearing of the point.
